$:set -euo pipefail
echo "SHALLOW $(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)"
if [ "$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" = true ]; then git fetch --unshallow origin main >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
echo '=== WORKFLOW HISTORY ==='
git log --follow --date=iso-strict --format='%H|%aI|%cI|%an|%s' -- .github/workflows/issue-comment-listener.yml
echo '=== FIRST JSON PARSE INSERTIONS ==='
git log --follow -S 'Issue comment must contain valid JSON' --date=iso-strict --format='MATCH %H|%aI|%cI|%s' -- .github/workflows/issue-comment-listener.yml
echo '=== DISPATCHER CREATION ==='
git log --follow --diff-filter=A --date=iso-strict --format='ADDED %H|%aI|%cI|%s' -- .github/workflows/issue-comment-listener.yml
echo '=== FILE HISTORY SUMMARY ==='
git log --follow --stat --format='DATE %aI COMMIT %H %s' -- .github/workflows/issue-comment-listener.yml
